plan.failureSummary: Cached page.ai replay failed to locate 'Last Name' input because the live survey form presents different fields ('Your Name', 'Contact Email', 'Occupation').
observedIndicators: Failure occurred directly during deterministic cache replay execution in .cache-lock/unstable-survey.test.ts.cache.js.
Cached step attempted to fill 'Last Name *' / '[data-testid=\'input-lastname\']' which is absent in the failure screenshot.
Failure screenshot displays alternative form fields ('Your Name *', 'Contact Email *', 'Occupation *').
The page.ai instruction is semantically flexible ('Fill out the all of the survey questions with fake data...').
Flow history shows previous successful autonomous/retry runs across changing survey variations.

remediationSteps.summary: Clear Page.AI cache and re-run automation
remediationSteps.details: Clear the cached Page.AI file for unstable-survey.test.ts and re-run the test to allow autonomous generation against the current form layout.

plan.notes: The survey form structure dynamically changes or was modified. Re-running page.ai autonomously with cleared cache will allow it to adapt to the current form fields and complete the submission.
